render: 2048x1152, 48 samples, Cycles CPU seed 7, AgX Medium High Contrast, exposure +0.35 (editorial) as round 1
light: round-1 editorial daylight (sky 7.0 + soft area light outside every window + roof lights + AO 0.30) PLUS the room's S12 lamps at 2700 K (emissive shade + light source). Daylight-only (lamps off) per frame in extra/.
lamp_power: 2700 K (linear RGB (1.0, 0.56, 0.25)). Shades: emission 6; LED strips / opal discs: emission 14. Light sources (W, Blender radiometric): pendants 30-60 (disc under the shade), sconces 12-20 (point in front of the shade), LED profiles 12 W/m (rectangle under the shelf), niche 5, floor lamp 30+12, picture lights 8 each; bath ceiling light 18, shower downlight 12. Set by eye for a readable warm pool without clipping; not photometric.
scene: one combined scene: plan 1.0 + round-1 picks H-B, C-B, W-A, MB-A + round-2 kids, bath, kitchen-dining + S11/S12 additions

H-B: G-H4: reveal lining 2 cm on the hall half of the reveal (Y 6.27-6.35) + 10 cm casing on the hall face; assumed profile
C-B: G-C3: 4 cm oak lining Y 9.70-9.95 (lintel drops to 2.62) + 10 cm casing on the hall face; assumed profile
W-A: G-W1: built-in desk X -1.625..-0.025 x 0.60 deep, top 0.76; shelf at 1.62; art 60x50 between; chair at Y 7.30; door leaf folded on the south wall X 0.61-0.65 Y 9.00-9.90
MB-A: G-M3: tall planter (option 'tall planter or lounge chair') at (1.45, 18.15), crown to 1.75; basket and pendant of the plan kept
boy: G-K4: paint #A7B09A as a 1 mm layer 1 mm in front of the east (Y 10.25) and north (X -2.30) walls, Z 0.149-1.25 (under the window only to 0.724, below the sill board); skirting of those two walls in the paint colour

framed-prints: two 30x40 portrait frames (the slot format) do not fit the plan range X 0.45-0.95 (0.50 m); kept the format and centred the pair on X 0.70 with a 4 cm gap: X 0.38-0.68 / 0.72-1.02, Z 1.42-1.82 (top matches the est v 0.055)

boy: bed boards to 0.60, mattress top 0.42 (+ duvet to 0.50); kid chair seat 0.43 / back 0.72 (the est back_top_v 0.62 implies ~0.72); slot proxies each in their own warm grey, the paint is the only colour
